verdict.rationale: GitBook documents site customization of the published docs' appearance and lists 'advanced branding options' and custom blocks on its pricing page, so brand-matching theming is clearly supported at a basic level. Nothing in the evidence shows custom CSS/JS injection, and font or layout controls are not described. A community user also reported that landing page customization was limited. Missing for 10: evidence of custom CSS/JS support, explicit font and layout controls, documented own-component support beyond the 'custom blocks' mention, and independent corroboration of deep theming.
